title: The Sovereign Who Traversed the Earth's Ends
intro: Imagine a powerful ruler, granted strength and authority over the land. This figure embarked on extraordinary journeys, reaching the place where the sun sets and the place where it rises, encountering strange peoples and facing a great challenge from two corrupting nations. Who is this enigmatic leader?
clues: I was a ruler granted authority and means to reach the farthest corners of the earth.
I journeyed to the west and witnessed the sun setting in a murky spring.
I encountered a people near the rising sun who had no shelter from its heat.
Another community asked my help against two corrupting nations known as Gog and Magog.
I built a barrier using iron and molten copper to contain them.
I declared that this barrier was a mercy from my Lord, and it will remain until the appointed time.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
